mapper.select: /* LeavePromotionMapper.selectPromotionCandidates */ SELECT U.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , U.SITE_CD AS siteCd , U.USER_CD AS userCd , BASE.GRANT_ID AS baseGrantId , BASE.AVAIL_TO_DATE AS baseAvailToDate , IFNULL(REM.REMAINING_DAYS, 0) AS remainingDays , IF(FM.USER_CD IS NULL, 'N', 'Y') AS firstMasterYn , FM.NOTICED_DATE AS firstNoticedDate FROM TB_USER U JOIN TB_LEAVE_POLICY P ON P.CMPNY_CD = U.CMPNY_CD AND P.USE_YN = 'Y' AND P.AXIS7_USE_PROMOTION = 'Y' /* 소정-05 게이트 ②: 법정 연차 자동 부여를 끈 회사(5인 미만 등)는 사용촉진 배치 대상에서 제외. 컬럼은 NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Y' 라 기존 전 회사는 종전대로 후보에 남는다(무회귀). */ AND P.STATUTORY_AUTO_GRANT_YN = 'Y' JOIN ( /* 사용자별 가장 임박한 본연차(STATUTORY_ANNUAL) ACTIVE grant 1건 (역산 기준) */ SELECT G1.CMPNY_CD , G1.USER_CD , G1.GRANT_ID , G1.AVAIL_TO_DATE FROM TB_USER_LEAVE_GRANT G1 WHERE G1.GRANT_TYPE = 'STATUTORY_ANNUAL' AND G1.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND G1.DEL_YN = 'N' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_USER_LEAVE_GRANT G2 WHERE G2.CMPNY_CD = G1.CMPNY_CD AND G2.USER_CD = G1.USER_CD AND G2.GRANT_TYPE = 'STATUTORY_ANNUAL' AND G2.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND G2.DEL_YN = 'N' AND ( G2.AVAIL_TO_DATE < G1.AVAIL_TO_DATE OR (G2.AVAIL_TO_DATE = G1.AVAIL_TO_DATE AND G2.GRANT_ID < G1.GRANT_ID) ) ) ) BASE ON BASE.CMPNY_CD = U.CMPNY_CD AND BASE.USER_CD = U.USER_CD LEFT JOIN ( /* 본연차+근속가산 ACTIVE 잔여 합(월차/약정 제외) */ SELECT R.CMPNY_CD , R.USER_CD , SUM(R.GRANT_DAYS - R.USED_DAYS) AS REMAINING_DAYS FROM TB_USER_LEAVE_GRANT R WHERE R.GRANT_TYPE IN ('STATUTORY_ANNUAL', 'STATUTORY_TENURE_BONUS') AND R.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND R.DEL_YN = 'N' GROUP BY R.CMPNY_CD, R.USER_CD ) REM ON REM.CMPNY_CD = U.CMPNY_CD AND REM.USER_CD = U.USER_CD LEFT JOIN ( /* 해당 회차 1차(FIRST) 통지 마스터. STATUS 필터 없음 — NOTICED/DESIGNATED/COMPLETED/CLOSED 무엇이든 "통지 사실"은 존재하므로 DEL_YN 만 적용. UNIQUE(CMPNY_CD, DEDUP_KEY)로 회차당 1행이 보장되지만 과거 데이터 방어로 GROUP BY + MIN(NOTICED_DATE)(최초 통지일 채택). */ SELECT M1.CMPNY_CD , M1.USER_CD , M1.BASE_AVAIL_TO_DATE , MIN(M1.NOTICED_DATE) AS NOTICED_DATE FROM TB_LEAVE_PROMOTION_LOG M1 WHERE M1.PROMO_STAGE = 'FIRST' AND M1.DEL_YN = 'N' GROUP BY M1.CMPNY_CD, M1.USER_CD, M1.BASE_AVAIL_TO_DATE ) FM ON FM.CMPNY_CD = U.CMPNY_CD AND FM.USER_CD = U.USER_CD AND FM.BASE_AVAIL_TO_DATE = BASE.AVAIL_TO_DATE WHERE U.USE_YN = 'Y' AND U.ACCOUNT_STATUS = '01' AND IFNULL(REM.REMAINING_DAYS, 0) > 0 ORDER BY U.CMPNY_CD, U.USER_CD

/* LeavePromotionMapper.selectPromotionCandidate */ SELECT U.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , U.SITE_CD AS siteCd , U.USER_CD AS userCd , BASE.GRANT_ID AS baseGrantId , BASE.AVAIL_TO_DATE AS baseAvailToDate , IFNULL(REM.REMAINING_DAYS, 0) AS remainingDays , IF(FM.USER_CD IS NULL, 'N', 'Y') AS firstMasterYn , FM.NOTICED_DATE AS firstNoticedDate FROM TB_USER U JOIN TB_LEAVE_POLICY P ON P.CMPNY_CD = U.CMPNY_CD AND P.USE_YN = 'Y' AND P.AXIS7_USE_PROMOTION = 'Y' /* 소정-05 게이트 ②: 배치와 동일 판정(recomputeForUser 단건 재판정). off 회사는 도래 후보 제외 */ AND P.STATUTORY_AUTO_GRANT_YN = 'Y' JOIN ( SELECT G1.GRANT_ID , G1.AVAIL_TO_DATE FROM TB_USER_LEAVE_GRANT G1 WHERE G1.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND G1.USER_CD = #{userCd} AND G1.GRANT_TYPE = 'STATUTORY_ANNUAL' AND G1.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND G1.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY G1.AVAIL_TO_DATE ASC, G1.GRANT_ID ASC LIMIT 1 ) BASE LEFT JOIN ( SELECT SUM(R.GRANT_DAYS - R.USED_DAYS) AS REMAINING_DAYS FROM TB_USER_LEAVE_GRANT R WHERE R.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND R.USER_CD = #{userCd} AND R.GRANT_TYPE IN ('STATUTORY_ANNUAL', 'STATUTORY_TENURE_BONUS') AND R.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND R.DEL_YN = 'N' ) REM ON 1 = 1 LEFT JOIN ( /* 해당 사용자 회차 FIRST 마스터(목록 쿼리 FM 과 동형, 사용자 1명 스코프) */ SELECT M1.USER_CD , M1.BASE_AVAIL_TO_DATE , MIN(M1.NOTICED_DATE) AS NOTICED_DATE FROM TB_LEAVE_PROMOTION_LOG M1 WHERE M1.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND M1.USER_CD = #{userCd} AND M1.PROMO_STAGE = 'FIRST' AND M1.DEL_YN = 'N' GROUP BY M1.USER_CD, M1.BASE_AVAIL_TO_DATE ) FM ON FM.USER_CD = U.USER_CD AND FM.BASE_AVAIL_TO_DATE = BASE.AVAIL_TO_DATE WHERE U.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND U.USER_CD = #{userCd} AND U.USE_YN = 'Y' AND U.ACCOUNT_STATUS = '01' AND IFNULL(REM.REMAINING_DAYS, 0) > 0 LIMIT 1

/* LeavePromotionMapper.selectActiveFirstContext */ SELECT U.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , U.SITE_CD AS siteCd , U.USER_CD AS userCd , BASE.GRANT_ID AS baseGrantId , BASE.AVAIL_TO_DATE AS baseAvailToDate , IFNULL(REM.GRANTED_DAYS, 0) AS grantedDays , IFNULL(REM.REMAINING_DAYS, 0) AS remainingDays , M.LOGIN_NOTIFIED_YN AS loginNotifiedYn FROM TB_USER U JOIN TB_LEAVE_POLICY P ON P.CMPNY_CD = U.CMPNY_CD AND P.USE_YN = 'Y' AND P.AXIS7_USE_PROMOTION = 'Y' JOIN ( SELECT G1.GRANT_ID , G1.AVAIL_TO_DATE FROM TB_USER_LEAVE_GRANT G1 WHERE G1.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND G1.USER_CD = #{userCd} AND G1.GRANT_TYPE = 'STATUTORY_ANNUAL' AND G1.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND G1.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY G1.AVAIL_TO_DATE ASC, G1.GRANT_ID ASC LIMIT 1 ) BASE LEFT JOIN ( SELECT SUM(R.GRANT_DAYS) AS GRANTED_DAYS , SUM(R.GRANT_DAYS - R.USED_DAYS) AS REMAINING_DAYS FROM TB_USER_LEAVE_GRANT R WHERE R.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND R.USER_CD = #{userCd} AND R.GRANT_TYPE IN ('STATUTORY_ANNUAL', 'STATUTORY_TENURE_BONUS') AND R.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND R.DEL_YN = 'N' ) REM ON 1 = 1 JOIN TB_LEAVE_PROMOTION_LOG M ON M.CMPNY_CD = U.CMPNY_CD AND M.USER_CD = U.USER_CD AND M.PROMO_STAGE = 'FIRST' AND M.BASE_AVAIL_TO_DATE = BASE.AVAIL_TO_DATE AND M.STATUS IN ('NOTICED', 'COMPLETED') AND M.DEL_YN = 'N' WHERE U.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND U.USER_CD = #{userCd} AND U.USE_YN = 'Y' AND U.ACCOUNT_STATUS = '01' AND IFNULL(REM.REMAINING_DAYS, 0) > 0 LIMIT 1
